interest: Dutch surveillance of General Itagaki's 1934 visit to Java.
overview: Patton's 1934 despatch: Dutch police watched General Itagaki in Java, where he lectured on Manchukuo rather than spying.

people.name: Seishiro Itagaki
people.role: Major General of the Imperial Japanese Army

people.name: Johannes Osten
people.role: Admiral, Director of the Department of Marine of Netherland India

subfiles.about: Consul General Patton reports on his inquiries with Dutch naval authorities regarding the visit of Japanese Major General Seishiro Itagaki to Java and Dutch surveillance of his activities.
subfiles.from: K. S. Patton, American Consul General, Batavia
subfiles.summary: Patton reports Admiral Osten's view that General Itagaki was lecturing Japanese residents on Manchukuo under close Dutch surveillance, not spying.
